title: Stone Buying Office Note on the Sourcing Uplift Within a Metal Market Repricing
content:
# Stone Buying Office Note on the Sourcing Uplift Within a Metal Market Repricing

Where the quote on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is rebuilt for a movement in the metal market, the sourcing uplift on a stone sourced to order turns on where the centre stone comes from and on whether a charge for a stone upgrade stands booked on the commission.

## The rates

1. Where the centre stone is one sourced to order and a charge for a stone upgrade stands booked on the commission, the sourcing uplift is the programme's stone sourcing fee rate on that charge.
2. Where the centre stone is one sourced to order and no charge for a stone upgrade stands booked, it is 3 per cent on the quoted total.
3. Otherwise nothing is added for the sourcing of the centre stone.

The centre stone's source stands on the commission record. A charge for a stone upgrade stands booked where the commission's entries under the stone upgrade reason come to more than nothing.

## The programme's stone sourcing fee rate

| Programme | Stone sourcing fee rate |
|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 0 per cent |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 6 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 8 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 8 per cent |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 6 per cent |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 12 per cent |

## Readings (hypothetical)

- A Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission whose centre stone is sourced to order, with a stone upgrade charge of USD 5000.00 standing: the uplift is 6 per cent of USD 5000.00, that is USD 300.00.
- The same commission with no stone upgrade charge standing and a quoted total of USD 30000.00: the uplift is 3 per cent of USD 30000.00, that is USD 900.00.
- A commission whose centre stone came from the chain's own inventory, or which the customer supplied, or which was taken from an heirloom piece: nothing is added for the sourcing of the centre stone.
